thesis: This episode argues that while Nvidia remains the dominant force in AI hardware due to superior supply chain efficiency and cost, other major players like Google, Amazon, and Meta are rapidly scaling their custom silicon and infrastructure investments to compete. It suggests that the most valuable companies in this space are those effectively tapping capital markets to fund massive CapEx, such as CoreWeave and Oracle, while traditional infrastructure giants like Brookfield and Blackstone are pivoting heavily toward AI.
